none: PAS WAW-B9A540: Roman Coin: Barbarous radiate of a 3rd century emperor
contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy barbarous radiate dating to the late 3rd century, circa AD275-285 (Reece Period 14). The reverse has a simplistic depiction of a standing figure possibly holding a spear which may be a crude copy of a VIRTVS AVG reverse type depicting a soldier right with spear and shield. Obverse shows a simplistic depiction of a radiate bust facing right. There is no obverse legend. Diameter:…
